units.function: Mocked post-approval service tests that notify an Agent's active server adapter and log success/failure/error without failing the hiring path.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> notifyHireApproved -> mocked Agent lookup/adapter registry/onHireApproved/activity log; no real database, approval record, Connector, transaction or retry worker is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Company/Agent/adapter/config, approval or join-request source ID, adapter hook ok/error/detail and hire-hook activity action/details.
units.lifecycle: Load approved Agent -> find adapter -> optional provisioning callback -> append success/failure/error activity -> always return; missing Agent/hook no-op.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 5/5 with all meaningful dependencies mocked. The cases pin best-effort semantics but do not establish tenant-safe lookup, idempotency, durable retry, approval identity, redaction or a usable post-hire state machine.
units.designRationale: Keep external adapter provisioning from rolling back or breaking an already-approved hire while leaving an operational activity trail when the callback exists and fails.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must distinguish organizational Agent activation and accountable role assignment from Connector provisioning, then reconcile each durable state without granting authority to an unbound or partially provisioned runtime.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT as an idempotent saga/outbox: Approval activates an AgentPrincipal/RoleAssignment/ResponsibilityContract only under exact policy; a separate ConnectorBinding transitions pending -> provisioning -> healthy/failed with retry and operator remediation. Raw adapter errors remain restricted diagnostics and public/audit outcomes use stable safe codes.
units.responsibilityConflict: source/sourceId is not a complete approval or responsibility chain. No approver, accountable manager, job/role, requested authority, data grant, Connector capability or result evidence is bound, and best-effort failure can leave authority and execution readiness inconsistent.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL authority/readiness inconsistency: approval succeeds even when Connector provisioning fails, with no durable reconciliation state. HIGH audit gap: missing Agent/hook silently no-op and activity is not shown durable/transactional. HIGH tenant gap: company-scoped Agent lookup is not asserted. HIGH error disclosure: raw adapter errors enter activity without tested redaction. HIGH idempotency gap: duplicate/concurrent callbacks and partial effects are untested. HIGH responsibility gap: approver, manager, role, capability and data authority are absent.
